name: Social Signal Retrieval
description_zh: 获取小红书、LinkedIn、微信公众号、X、Reddit 和知乎的公开账号与内容数据，检查账号链接和查询参数，并返回阅读、展示、点赞、评论、转发等平台数据；不做账号评分或策略决策。
description_en: Retrieve public account and content data from Xiaohongshu, LinkedIn, WeChat, X, Reddit, and Zhihu; check account links and search parameters, and return available platform metrics such as views, impressions, likes, comments, and shares without scoring accounts or making strategy decisions.
